stored_text.note: official.pdf is the full Serbian (Cyrillic) strategy text from the Ministry of Science site, with a text layer; the layer splits some words with stray spaces ('безбедн а') and drops the en dash in '2025–2030'. secondary.html is the Government's strategy page and gives the title in the nominative.

english_version.note: No English text in the stored files. One web search found an English condensed version of the earlier 2020-2025 strategy (OECD-hosted) and English news (Tanjug) and tracker summaries for 2025-2030, but no English text of the 2025-2030 strategy.

title.source_quote: Стратегија развоја вештачке интелигенције у Републици Србији за период 2025-2030. године
title.why: original_title matches the Government page title except that the record has an en dash where the page has a hyphen; the PDF heading has the same words in the accusative after 'Влада усваја' (СТРАТЕГИЈУ ...). The English follows the form the Government used for the 2020-2025 strategy and is accurate.

summary_claims.claim: Its first special objective is a clear institutional and legal framework through a dedicated law regulating the application of AI so that its use is secure, safe and reliable and aligned with international standards while enabling innovation.
summary_claims.original_quote: Обезбеди јасан и ефикасан институционални и правни оквир доношењем посебног закона који ће регулисати примену вештачке интелигенције , којим се омогућава њена сигурна, безбедн а и поуздан а примена усклађена са међународним стандардима и креирају услови за подстицање иновација
summary_claims.literal_translation: Ensure a clear and effective institutional and legal framework by adopting a special law that will regulate the application of artificial intelligence, enabling its safe, secure and trustworthy application in line with international standards, and creating conditions for encouraging innovation

summary_claims.claim: It reviews the risks to be addressed (privacy, algorithmic bias, misuse, inequality, absence of clear rules, energy use).
summary_claims.locator: page 10, section on the international context
summary_claims.original_quote: Етичка питања попут заштите приватности, пристрасности у алгоритмима и потенцијалних злоупотреба постају све важнија. Осим тога, постоји ризик да ће аутоматизација коју покреће ВИ повећати неједнакости
summary_claims.literal_translation: Ethical issues such as the protection of privacy, bias in algorithms and potential misuse are becoming ever more important. In addition, there is a risk that automation driven by AI will increase inequalities

summary_claims.claim: Secondary sources report that it schedules the AI law for the end of 2027.
summary_claims.original_quote: Циљна вредност за крај 2027. године: Пуна примена Закона о вештачкој интелигенцији
summary_claims.literal_translation: Target value for the end of 2027: Full application of the Law on Artificial Intelligence

key_terms.original: сигурна, безбедна и поуздана (примена вештачке интелигенције)
key_terms.note: The strategy itself glosses the same triad, in its reference to the UN General Assembly resolution, with the English 'safe, secure and trustworthy' (page 11: '(енг. Seizing the opportunities of safe, secure and trustworthy artificial intelligence systems for sustainable development)'). 'Reliable' for 'поуздана' is a possible dictionary sense but not the sense the document uses.

The general objective ('Употреба поуздане и одговорне вештачке интелигенције ...') and the 2023 Ethical Guidelines use this phrase; the summary does not render it, so there is nothing inconsistent, but 'trustworthy' is the rendering to use if it is added.

key_terms.register_rendering: a dedicated law regulating the application of AI; the AI law
key_terms.note: The strategy also uses 'Закон о вештачкој интелигенцији' for the EU AI Act, which it glosses as '(енг. The Artificial Intelligence Act)'.

issues: The summary attributes the end-2027 timetable to 'secondary sources', but the stored strategy states it itself: the end-2027 target for Objective 1 is 'full application of the Law on Artificial Intelligence'. The hedge is process language that belongs in verification.note, and the claim should say 'full application by end-2027' rather than 'schedules the AI law'.
'secure, safe and reliable' renders 'сигурна, безбедна и поуздана'; the strategy's own English gloss of that triad is 'safe, secure and trustworthy'.
note: The legal basis (Article 38(1) of the Law on the Planning System), the predecessor 2020-2025 strategy and the risks listed (privacy, bias, misuse, inequality, lack of clear regulation, energy use) match the stored text.
